Kindness Ambassador.subject: 🎉 You’re a Kindness Ambassador!
Kindness Ambassador.message: Hooray! NEST4US is proud to recognize you as a KINDNESS AMBASSADOR for your 50+ hours of volunteer service. Thank you for spreading kindness and making the world brighter with every act you do!

Change Catalyst.subject: 🔥 You’ve Unlocked the Change Catalyst Tier!
Change Catalyst.message: Woohoo! NEST4US is proud to recognize you as a CHANGE CATALYST for your 100+ hours of volunteer service. Your passion and drive for making a difference are sparking real, lasting impact in communities near and far!

Service Champion.subject: 🏆 Welcome, Service Champion!
Service Champion.message: Hey there, changemaker! NEST4US is proud to recognize you as a SERVICE CHAMPION for your 150+ hours of volunteer service. Your consistent service uplifts lives and advances our collective vision of a more caring world for all!

Legacy Leader.subject: 👑 You Are Now a Legacy Leader!
Legacy Leader.message: You’ve gone above and beyond! NEST4US is proud to recognize you as a LEGACY LEADER for your 250+ hours of volunteer service. Your dedication has built a legacy of kindness and impact that will inspire generations to come!
